subject: Docket terms review of the Uncle Mike note: legal rates, thresholds and rate comparisons

items.label: AFR mid-term, semiannual compounding, October 2026
items.source: Rev. Rul. 2026-19 Table 1, mid-term AFR row (not 110% or higher), semiannual column (irs.gov/pub/irs-drop/rr-26-19.pdf); 26 USC 7872(f)(2)(A) says term loans are tested at the AFR compounded semiannually
items.note: Rev. Rul. 2026-19 Table 1 read from irs.gov PDF: mid-term AFR, semiannual column 4.56%; cross-check 2x((1.0461)^0.5-1)=4.558%

items.label: Gift tax annual exclusion per donee, calendar 2026
items.note: Rev. Proc. 2025-32 sec 4.42(1) read from irs.gov PDF: first $19,000 for calendar 2026

items.label: Form 1099-INT threshold for interest paid in the course of a trade or business
items.source: IRS Instructions for Forms 1099-INT and 1099-OID (Rev. 01/2024), irs.gov/instructions/i1099int, who must file
items.note: irs.gov/instructions/i1099int: at least $600 of interest paid in course of trade or business (general threshold is $10)

items.label: Washington general usury cap, fixed-percentage prong
items.note: RCW 19.52.020(1)(a) read at app.leg.wa.gov: twelve percent per annum

items.label: Florida civil usury cap, loans of $500,000 or less
items.note: Fla. Stat. 687.02(1) and 687.03(1) read at leg.state.fl.us: 18 percent per annum simple interest

items.label: Florida criminal usury threshold
items.note: Fla. Stat. 687.071(2): rate exceeding 25 percent per annum (2nd-degree misdemeanor; felony above 45)

items.label: Washington limitation period on a written contract, years
items.note: RCW 4.16.040(1) read at app.leg.wa.gov: six years

items.label: Option A effective annual rate at 7% nominal, monthly compounding
Lowest Option B implied annual return across all 18 cells, gross and net share, all caps
items.source: projects/600-se-101st-str/uncle-mike-options.csv, minimum across columns B_irr_1.3x, B_irr_1.4x, B_irr_1.5x and N_irr_1.4x, in percent; re-derive at least the minimum cell from rules M1 to M15
items.note: Re-derived from M1-M15 in own script before reading any CSV cell: min is net-share 65% (50k), 50%/$200, 1.4x, month 99, IRR 8.616%. Next lowest 8.74% (net 33%, 25k) then 9.34% (gross 1.3x)
